editorial.blurb: Min's Noodle House brings authentic Chongqing noodles to Bridgeport with bold, numbing spice and perfectly chewy noodles that deliver real soul-warming comfort.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the classic Chongqing noodle dish with minced pork — it's the town favorite — and don't miss the $10 tapa tray with beef shank and braised eggs; portions are generous enough to share with 1-2 people.
